tree.heading: Allow
tree.text: The term “allow”, with respect to the diversion through a country of goods, services, or technologies, means the government of the country knows or has reason to know that the territory of the country is being used for such diversion.

tree.heading: Commerce Control List
tree.text: The term “Commerce Control List” means the list maintained pursuant to part 774 of the Export Administration Regulations (or any corresponding similar regulation or ruling).

tree.heading: Divert; diversion
tree.text: The terms “divert” and “diversion” refer to the transfer or release, directly or indirectly, of a good, service, or technology to an end-user or an intermediary that is not an authorized recipient of the good, service, or technology.

tree.heading: End-user
tree.text: The term “end-user”, with respect to a good, service, or technology, means the person that receives and ultimately uses the good, service, or technology.

tree.heading: Export Administration Regulations
tree.text: The term “Export Administration Regulations” means subchapter C of chapter VII of title 15, Code of Federal Regulations (or any corresponding similar regulation or ruling).

tree.heading: Government
tree.text: The term “government” includes any agency or instrumentality of a government.

tree.heading: Intermediary
tree.text: The term “intermediary” means a person that receives a good, service, or technology while the good, service, or technology is in transit to the end-user of the good, service, or technology.

tree.heading: International Traffic in Arms Regulations
tree.text: The term “International Traffic in Arms Regulations” means subchapter M of chapter I of title 22, Code of Federal Regulations (or any corresponding similar regulation or ruling).

tree.heading: Iran
tree.text: The term “Iran” includes the Government of Iran and any agency or instrumentality of Iran.

tree.heading: Iranian end-user
tree.text: The term “Iranian end-user” means an end-user that is the Government of Iran or a person in, or an agency or instrumentality of, Iran.

tree.heading: Iranian intermediary
tree.text: The term “Iranian intermediary” means an intermediary that is the Government of Iran or a person in, or an agency or instrumentality of, Iran.

tree.heading: State sponsor of terrorism
tree.text: The term “state sponsor of terrorism” means any country the government of which the Secretary of State has determined has repeatedly provided support for acts of international terrorism pursuant to—

children.text: section 4605(j)(1)(A) 1 of title 50 (or any successor thereto);

tree.heading: United States Munitions List
tree.text: The term “United States Munitions List” means the list maintained pursuant to part 121 of the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (or any corresponding similar regulation or ruling).

notes.heading: Termination of Section
notes.text: For termination of section, see section 8551(a) of this title.

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: Section 4605(j)(1)(A) of title 50, referred to in par. (13)(A), was repealed by Pub. L. 115–232, div. A, title XVII, § 1766(a), Aug. 13, 2018, 132 Stat. 2232. Provisions similar to those in former section 4605(j)(1)(A) of title 50 can be found in section 4813(c)(1)(A)(i) of title 50, as enacted by Pub. L. 115–232.
